gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R2 (with TASK-089a); AC-8
cases.note: The first draw after launch has no last (KR-Q1): the 16-word pool, u 0 → REX. The queue is never quiet here, so no change.

cases.source: gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R2 (with TASK-089a); AC-8
cases.note: Q is not in the word: no light, counts toward nothing.

cases.source: gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R5 (KR-Q6); AC-7
cases.note: A row tap lights that key only; a hardware or hint G lights both. E and G make EGG Due.

cases.source: gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R2 (with TASK-089a) (KR-Q3, Q4, Q5); AC-9, AC-10
cases.note: Not while the queue holds a key, nor while a pointer is on a key (current position); the change draws at its start (last = REX: 15 candidates, u 0.125 → the 2nd, NEST). At +0.2 a tap hits the old E (it counts only for REX), at +0.4 the new N.

cases.source: gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R2 (with TASK-089a) (KR-Q1: last kept across a Title entry); AC-12
cases.note: u 0.1875 with no last → 3 (ROAR); then last 3: u 0 → 0 (REX); then last 0: 15 candidates, u 0.1875 → the 3rd, ROAR.

cases.source: gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R7; R2 (KR-Q4, Q9; TASK-089a); AC-14
cases.note: The same word and pressed letters after a short background; a Due word does not change during its fade-in, only once Showing (first frame at or after 0.3 s).

cases.source: gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R8 (KR-Q2, Q10); AC-15
cases.note: A keyboard is present. On: drawn at panel close (no last yet: u 0.125 → NEST). Off (v2, R8: under the panel a setting change takes effect at the close): at the close the hit rects go at once (a tap there is not a row press), the row fades out and the pressed set is dropped; NEST is kept only as last (u 0 → REX).

cases.source: gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R2c, R7 (play clock); AC-13
cases.note: Frozen at play 0.2: the light (tau 0.1) and the row fade-in (0.2 of 0.3) hold; after resume they continue.

cases.source: gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R8 (TASK-135, K-49); AC-1
cases.note: keyboardRow false = automatic: with no keyboard, Play entry fades the row in with a new word; touchable from the fade's start.

cases.source: gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R8 (TASK-135, K-49), R9 (the Mac: present is constant true); AC-1
cases.note: With a keyboard present nothing is drawn and there are no hit rects; this is also every Mac in Demo 1. No draw is consumed.

cases.source: gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R8 (TASK-135, K-49) (settle, inclusive at 0.5 s); AC-20, AC-21
cases.note: Connected at 1.0: unchanged before 1.5 (a tap at 1.4375 still presses E); at 1.5 the hit rects go and the row fades out (0.3 s, Hidden by 1.8125). Disconnected at 2.0: at 2.5 a new word is drawn with REX as last (15 candidates, u 0 → EGG).

cases.source: gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R8 (TASK-135, K-49); AC-21
cases.note: No last yet (nothing shown this run): 16 candidates, u 0.125 → NEST. Touchable during the fade-in.

cases.source: gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R8 (TASK-135, K-49) (the settled value is the last one reported); AC-22
cases.note: The GDD's 0.2 / 0.4 as the dyadic 0.25 / 0.375: true at 1.0, false at 1.25, true at 1.375; nothing until 1.875 (true held 0.5 s).

cases.source: gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R8 (TASK-135, K-49) (held since the first report; a repeat of the same value doesn't restart it)
cases.note: A second keyboard connecting (or a duplicate notification) reports true again; presence has held since 1.0, so it settles at 1.5, not 1.75.

cases.source: gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R8 (TASK-135, K-49) (applied at the close); AC-23
cases.note: Held 1.5 s under the dim, nothing shows; the close applies it with a newly drawn word.

cases.source: gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R8 (TASK-135, K-49) (applied at resume()); AC-23
gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R8 (TASK-135, K-49) (applied at resume(); the fade on the play clock)
cases.note: The play clock stops under the gate (1.0 to 3.0), so the fade-out started at resume ends at play 1.3 (uptime 3.3).

cases.source: gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R8 (TASK-135, K-49) (a pending change is dropped; the latest applies at once)
cases.note: Reported 0.125 s before the close: no settle, it applies at the close; nothing fires again at 3.375 (0.5 s after the report).

cases.source: gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R8 (TASK-135, K-49) (Title → Play entry uses the latest report)
cases.note: Connected 0.25 s before the entry: the entry applies it at once, so no row and no draw.

cases.source: gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R8 (TASK-135, K-49) (background: the return re-reads presence); R7; AC-14
cases.note: The connect at 2.0 never settled (dropped at the background); the return reads no keyboard, so the same word and pressed letter come back (R7).

cases.source: gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R8 (TASK-135, K-49); Edge Cases (attached while in the background)
cases.note: Hidden at once on return (no fade: nothing was drawn); REX becomes last, so the next draw (u 0, 15 candidates) is EGG.

cases.source: gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R8 (TASK-135, K-49) (newly shown at the return: the On rule, a new word)
gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R8 (TASK-135, K-49) (during a word change, last is the word drawn at the change's start; KR2-Q1)
cases.note: REX Due and quiet: the change at 0.5 draws NEST (last REX, u 0.125). A keyboard reported at 0.1875 settles at 0.6875, mid-change and before NEST's keys fade in (0.8): the row fades out with REX's keys still drawn. NEST, drawn at the change's start, is last, so the next draw (u 0.125 over the 15 words other than NEST) is EGG; with REX as last it would have been NEST again.

cases.source: gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R8 (TASK-135, K-49) (keyboardRow true = always); AC-24
gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R8 (TASK-135, K-49) (off means automatic); AC-15
cases.note: No keyboard: turning the switch off leaves shown true, so the hit rects stay and the word and pressed set are kept.

cases.source: gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R8 (TASK-135, K-49); States (Fading out → shown again → Fading in with a new word)
cases.note: A setting change and a presence change together: the row is still fading out (1.5 to 1.8) when the switch forces it on; it fades in with a new word (last REX, u 0 → EGG). The fade's start alpha (the current one) is not pinned here (v2 pins state, as v1).
